notes: The and before brought was given to the expressed answering de rather than treated as a supplied juncture under rule 88; men is left unrepresented under rule 70, the ASV writing no indeed.
katargesantos is anarthrous, so the supplied who is the participle's own rule 7 helper and no article is in question (rule 31).
photisantos heads on light under rules 17 and 91, brought being the empty frame verb, as rule 104's phlogizo -> setteth on fire heads on fire.
